title: Rebirth Wish

outfit_card.silhouette: Retro couture ensemble with a fitted olive jacquard vest over a puff-sleeve blouse, layered over a full bell-shaped skirt featuring a split-front white pleated panel and tiered lace hems, finished with a structured jacket arching over the shoulders.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A miniature olive top hat perched atop the head, adorned with clustered white roses and trailing forest-green ribbons, accompanied by a brass-buckled hatpin and delicate earrings.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High-necked sheer white organza blouse with pintucks and bishop sleeves ending in ruffled cuffs; layered beneath a fitted olive silk jacquard vest with gold topstitching, star-shaped brass buttons, and a golden ribbon bow at the throat.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Full olive skirt with an inverted front pleat revealing a white embroidered petticoat panel, edged with a checkered olive hem and ornate scalloped lace trim; worn with dark tights and buttoned olive ankle boots with vintage heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating origami paper cranes suspended on fine strings, a celestial star-and-cross motif, and a small handheld brass lantern charm, evoking wishful nostalgia.
